notes.title: Balance patch
notes.content:
Dr Ling:
Increased the cooldown rate for her warp step, allowing her to use the ability much more liberally.
Slightly increased health pool.
Decreased the amount of I-frames that she has from 1.3 seconds to 0.7 seconds, making it more risky to play her.

General:
Enabled bullet cancelling, and added a score value to bullets.

notes.title: NEW CHARACTER: DR. Ling
notes.content:
[h2]NEW CHARACTER: DR. Ling[/h2]
[previewyoutube=i5KzaoQZw7k;full][/previewyoutube]

Dr Ling is the latest character added to Undercroft warriors! She's a technomancer that can reconfigure herself and her weapons into any shape she feels like! Flamethrowers, handheld particle accelerators, bazookas, she has it all! But here's the catch, it's what SHE decides to use that goes. So for you, dear player, it's entirely random what weapon you'll get!

[h3]Other news[/h3]
The game recently received a few optimization updates, and the unlock shop is now adequately sorted by category.

notes.title: March 8 adjustment patch
notes.content:
Undercroft Warriors, March 8th Patch
Balance changes:

The grenade launcher that agent Y found is pretty effective, but also kind of heavy. That and dread sneakily drained some of his vitality.

Reduced the amount of ronin dashes that he can do to 3.

Dread got a bit more than he bargained for after draining Agent Y - Not only can he tumble through faster, further and more often, he also got physically stronger! He can now throw knives rather than just swing them around halfhazardly, and his aim with his pistol got refined so much that he can pierce through infinite enemies!

Increased the range of tactical roll SIGNIFICANTLY
Increased the amount of tactical roll charges to 6
Pistol now has infinite pierce, and longer range.

General changes:

Adjusted hitboxes for different projectiles and enemies - Should now be more accurate
Enemies should no longer be invisible
Changed the damage tell for The plague doctor - Should now be more clear when he takes damage

Miscellaneous changes:

Added a satellite ammo indicator to the Minimal hud

notes.title: Update: Balance and graphical overhaul
notes.content:
1. Balance changes

Agent Y "lost" his SMG (threw it in the bin), and found a new grenade launcher called the thumper!
He'd rather have a shotgun, but exploding baddies by the dozen is good enough for him.

Slayer received some maintenance and cleaning, and it turns out that all of the dirt and grime was actually somewhat integral to his defenses. Massive nerf to his defenses, and small buff to Little Bess and the assault shield. Little bess can now fire shots in rapid succession rather than sneezing them out (her barrel was clogged) and the assault shield can now be deployed more often, thanks to the cleaning that he received.

2. Graphical overhaul

The game now has a new look, with a lot more dithering! Enjoy the new more comic-like feel of the game!

3. Varia

Fixed a performance bug that was caused by the game rendering itself 2 times
Added a new quick-draw button - It draws and fires the unequipped weapon when pressed, and holsters it when released.

Anyhow, if you're reading this, and that you enjoyed the game, please don't forget to leave a positive review on the store page! It helps a lot, and frankly, it just feels nice.

notes.title: 1.3 - ROBOT INVASION UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551290/031d15f404cf84284cf3f86edf32c7cdd751e30b.png[/img]
[h1]1.3 - ROBOT INVASION UPDATE[/h1]

[h3]NEW - Slayer[/h3]
Slayer is a deadly killing machine that somehow gained a soul, and now fights for humanity.  
This character has by a wide margin the highest health in the game, and a powerful ability called assault shield, which allows them to damage enemies, shield from damage, and recover a small amount of health per second.

However, unlike every other character in the game, Slayer does not recover health passively, meaning that you'll have to use  assault shield wisely!

[h3]NEW - Additional palettes[/h3]
New palettes have been added to the game! check them out!

[h3]NEW - Accessibility and quality of life changes[/h3]
Controller aim has been revamped, with major adjustments, and new options!

You can now toggle an enemy outline!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2!
notes.content:
in version 1.2, you now have leaderboards and new palettes! 

[b]LEADERBOARDS[/b]

The leaderboards are available across steam AND itch, thanks to Gdevelop's leaderboard hosting! The leaderboards are separated by gamemode, and I hope that the competition heats up in there!

[b]PALETTES[/b]

A new unlockable appeared! Palettes! Tired of the standard colors? Want a change of scenery? Palettes are there for you! By spending a very small amount of 800 000 points, you can get ONE palette! It's very pretty!
